newsitem.title: USA: Advance Financial sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Advance Financial sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Advance Financial Bancorp said Thursday its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan intended to ensure fair and equal treatment to shareholders in the event of any takeover proposal.

It said its board has declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each common share outstanding. The plan would be triggered if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or announces a tender offer for that size of a stake or more.
A spokeswoman said she did not know of any takeover interest in the company, parent of Advance Financial Savings Bank.
Each right under the plan will entitle the holder to buy one one-hundredth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $37, it said.
The company said the dividend distribution will be made on July 31, payable to stockholders of record on that date. The rights expire on July 17, 2007, it said.
